# GEO report: quay-store **New to GEO?** GEO (generative engine optimization) means making your site easy for search engines and AI tools to find, read and quote. This report checks the technical basics. ## Code score: 40/100, At risk Confidence: High (checked 25 of 25 points). How it's calculated: low = 12 ÷ 25 × 100 = 48. High = (12 + 0) ÷ 25 × 100 = 48. A cap of 40 applies, so both numbers are 40. The cap is there because `robots.txt` blocks Googlebot from the whole site, which is a blocker under GEO-009. Nothing was left unknown. The score is low mainly because of one line in `robots.txt`, and a few small fixes would raise it a long way. All results are read from code, not measured on a live site. ## Live check - **Not run.** To add it, give me your site's URL. ## Do these first ### 1. Stop blocking Googlebot in robots.txt - **Why it matters:** Googlebot is told to stay out of the entire site, so Google can't crawl any page. This also makes every page unindexable in practice, which is why GEO-009 and GEO-014 both fail. - **Where:** `static/robots.txt:4-5` - **What the code says:** `User-agent: Googlebot` / `Disallow: /` - **Size:** Small - **Score after this:** 72/100. That is 18 ÷ 25 = 72, and the cap no longer applies. ### 2. Make pages render on the server - **Why it matters:** With server rendering off, the HTML a crawler receives is an empty shell. The headings, text, title, description and canonical links are only added by JavaScript in the browser. - **Where:** `src/routes/+layout.ts:1` - **What the code says:** `export const ssr = false;` - **Size:** Small. Remove the line, or prerender the pages. - **Score after this:** On its own, the code score stays at 40 because the cap still applies (the raw figure is 15 ÷ 25 = 60). After fix 1, it is 21 ÷ 25 = 84. ### 3. Set the page language and fill the empty shop description - **Why it matters:** The `` tag has no `lang`, so tools can't tell what language the pages are in. The shop page has a blank description, so it has no summary of its own. - **Where:** `src/app.html:2` and `src/routes/shop/+page.svelte:3` - **What the code says:** `` and `` - **Size:** Small - **Score after this:** On its own, the code score stays at 40 because the cap still applies (the raw figure is 14 ÷ 25 = 56). After fixes 1 and 2, it is 23 ÷ 25 = 92. ## All results | Rule | What it checks | Code | Where | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | GEO-013 | robots.txt is readable and valid | Clear | `static/robots.txt`, plain text with valid lines | | GEO-009 | Search crawlers have access | Problem | `static/robots.txt:4-5` blocks Googlebot site-wide. I assumed you want to be found, since there's no config. | | GEO-014 | Routes are indexable | Problem | `/` and `/shop` are blocked from Googlebot by `static/robots.txt:5`. `/search` is deliberately noindex and isn't in the sitemap or navigation, so I left it out. | | GEO-015 | Absolute canonical on own domain | Clear | `/` and `/shop` have absolute canonicals on `quay.example`. `/search` is noindex. | | GEO-003 | Content is in server HTML | Problem | `src/routes/+layout.ts:1` has `ssr = false`, and I found no prerendering. Affects all 3 routes. | | GEO-004 | JSON-LD is valid | Problem | `src/routes/shop/+page.svelte:5` has a `Product` with only `name`. It has no `offers`, `review` or `aggregateRating`. This is the only JSON-LD entry. | | GEO-011 | Sitemap is valid and discoverable | Clear | `static/sitemap.xml` is valid, and `robots.txt:7` has an absolute `Sitemap:` line. | | GEO-012 | Title, description and `lang` | Problem | `src/app.html:2` has no `lang`. `src/routes/shop/+page.svelte:3` has an empty description. This is judged on `/` and `/shop`. | | GEO-016 | Routes reachable by real links | Clear | `src/routes/+layout.svelte:5` has `` links to `/` and `/shop`. | | GEO-017 | Snippet limits don't conflict | Clear | Only an element-level `data-nosnippet` at `+layout.svelte:7`, which is a deliberate choice. | | GEO-002 | Accessibility basics | Clear | I read the layout and the 3 pages. They have no images, and the nav links have text. | | GEO-101 | Mobile app association files | Not applicable | No app declared. | | GEO-010 | llms.txt presence | Not scored | Not present. | | GEO-102 | App structured data | Not scored | None. | ## Other problems found - **Bot rules contradict each other:** `static/robots.txt:1-2` says `User-agent: *` / `Allow: /`, but `:4-5` blocks Googlebot. Fix this with item 1 above. - **Product data on a listing page:** `src/routes/shop/+page.shtml`'s `{@html ...Product...}` at `src/routes/shop/+page.svelte:5` describes one "Bilge pump", but the page lists several parts. Either mark up a real product page or use an `ItemList`. ## Worth considering - **Give each product its own page:** `src/routes/shop/+page.svelte:9`: `

Bilge pumps, cleats and rope.

`. Separate pages and addresses for these items would give them something to be found and quoted by. Add them to the sitemap too. - **Add prices and availability to the Product data:** `src/routes/shop/+page.svelte:5`: `"name":"Bilge pump"`. Add `offers` with price and stock if the page shows them. - **Back up the delivery claim:** `src/routes/+page.svelte:7`: `Marine parts shipped next day.` Say where it applies, the cutoff time and the cost. `src/routes/+layout.svelte:7` has the "Free delivery over £50" text, which is in `data-nosnippet`. Put the facts on a visible delivery page. - **Add a `viewport` meta tag:** `src/app.html:4` has only `charset`. Add ``. - **Add Organization and WebSite data:** nothing states who Quay is in machine-readable form. Add JSON-LD with the name and URL to the layout. - **Improve titles:** `src/routes/shop/+page.svelte:2`: `Shop all parts`. Something like "Boat parts shop | Quay" would say what the page is and who it's from. `src/routes/+page.svelte:2` has `Quay: boat parts` and could do the same. - **Add `
` landmarks:** the pages don't use `
`. `src/routes/+layout.svelte:6` renders the children directly, so wrapping them in `
` would help. - **Add `` to the sitemap:** `static/sitemap.xml:3-4` has no dates. Add them if you have real update dates. - **Link the pages to each other:** the home page and the shop page have no links to each other apart from the nav. Link from the home headline to the shop categories. - **Don't hand-keep the sitemap:** `static/sitemap.xml` is hand-written. Generate it from the routes once there are more pages. ## Can't tell from code - **Bot protection:** code can't show whether a CDN or firewall lets real crawlers through. Run `geopilot logs ` to check real crawlers against their published addresses. - **Prerendering at the host:** I found no adapter or prerender setup in the repository. If your host prerenders pages, a live check would settle GEO-003. ## Assumptions - You want search engines and AI tools to find this site. There's no `geo.config.json`, so I took `quay.example` as the domain from the canonicals. - I read everything tracked in the repository: 3 routes, the layout, `app.html`, `robots.txt` and `sitemap.xml`. That includes the only JSON-LD source. There's no config file, router file or other shared component to read. - `/search` is noindex on purpose, and I left it alone. ## What to do next 1. Run the geopilot `fix` command to apply item 1. You'll see every change before anything is written. 2. Run the geopilot `explain` command with any rule id, such as `GEO-014`, to learn more. 3. For proof from a running site, ask for a live scan with its URL. Technical readiness only. GEO does not measure or predict citations, rankings, traffic or inclusion in any AI or search product.
